'''June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (15 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament held on 15 June 2003 at Twin City Comics in Columbia Heights, Minnesota, the last "Road to States" event before the [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]]. Fourteen players took part, and [[Jim Li]] won; he was 8–0 and had won both tournaments he had played since returning for the summer. All six Road to States events drew at least ten players.<ref name="pcf-1291-29358">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=29358#29358 2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 June 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040318152912/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=1291%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota<ref name="pcf-1291-29358" />
* '''Dates:''' 15 June 2003<ref name="pcf-1291-29358" />
* '''Players:''' 14<ref name="pcf-1291-29358" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Jim Li]]<ref name="pcf-1291-29358" />

== Games ==

In [[Nick Kolnik]]'s first game, against a player named Ike, his [[Worrt]], enhanced by [[Tauntaun Bones (V)]], ate [[Bossk With Mortar Gun]] and [[Jodo Kast]]. When Ike deployed the [[Sarlacc]], the two creatures attacked each other and the Sarlacc's ferocity destiny was 0, so the Worrt ate the Sarlacc. About ten minutes later Caleb Grace completed an [[Attack Run]] for 18 Force in a [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue The Princess]] deck. No games timed out.<ref name="pcf-1291-29358" />
